title: Union, intersection and difference of integer sets
summary: Build two sets from integer lists with repeats, then return their union, intersection and difference as the library's own set values.
notes: Every entry builds two sets and three new ones inside the call, so construction and growth are a large part of each figure. Ordered sets (ordered-set, sorted_set) keep an order the hash sets do not, and pay for it here. Rust allocation-counting overhead is included in CPU figures.
